Welcome to Fathomry

Start with one explicit source and one caller-owned context.
Prepare settings offline; construct the public Runtime and evidence Inbox from
its policy. Keep the source Owner, not an SDK client. Prepare the welcome message,
inspect its MIME, and send only to an explicitly authorized recipient.

A relay acknowledgement is not inbox placement or human reading. Observe finite
evidence independently, close the source, acknowledge its source record, and
close the Runtime. Never retry a message merely because its evidence is redelivered.
